column1: # Settings presets: Performance, Balanced and Quality, as values of settings.tsv rows for each device class. A launcher shows a Preset row; choosing one sets these settings
# (dm/games/settings.py writes the preset lists into launcher.json for the app's device class). Only values with a measurement behind them are here; a setting a preset does not name keeps
# its default (a preset resolves to every setting any preset of the device names, so choosing it also puts those back to the default). A setting a game does not offer is skipped;
# a value its row does not accept is an error. A preset that ends up equal to the defaults is not offered, except Balanced. Docs: docs/settings.md, Presets.
#   device  tv (Apple TV 4K, A15), phone (iPhone and iPad), mac
#   game    * for every game that has the setting, or one title ID
#   variable, value  a setting of settings.tsv and the value the preset gives it (the value the variable takes: a toggle's on/off words as its row says)
#   source  the measurement the value comes from (docs/settings.md, Presets, has the details)
